sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
char_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

print(f"Character: {char_nodes[0]['boundary'] if char_nodes else 'not found'}")
print(f"Green: {len(green_nodes)}")

# Sort green platforms by position (top to bottom, left to right)
green_sorted = sorted(green_nodes, key=lambda n: (min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])))

# Convert one green platform and check
n = green_sorted[0]
rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
print(f"Converting first green at ({center_row}, {center_col})")

result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}])
print(f"  gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}, no_impact={last_action_result.get('no_impact')}")

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
green2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
char2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
print(f"Green remaining: {len(green2)}, Character: {char2[0]['boundary'] if char2 else 'not found'}")

# Check if any new objects appeared
for color in ['P', 'M', 'R', 'O']:
    nodes = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == color]
    if nodes:
        print(f"{color}: {len(nodes)} objects")

# Check if level changed
print(f"Level: {current_frame.level}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
